description: This Java source file defines the MockZoneCluster class, which simulates a Zigbee IAS Zone cluster (cluster ID 0x0500). It provides methods to manipulate and query the state of a fake Zigbee door/window sensor, including tamper, fault, battery status, and zone type. The class also handles attribute data and commands related to the zone cluster.

classes.name: MockZoneCluster
classes.description: A mock implementation of a Zigbee IAS Zone cluster to simulate device behavior.

classes.description: Enumeration of possible zone types for the simulated zone.

classes.description: Represents the status flags of the zone, including tamper, battery, trouble, etc.

classes.description: Constants for server-initiated commands in the zone cluster.
